skills.description: Detects potential infinite loops and runaway token usage risks in Claw AI workflows by analyzing retry, recursion, and termination conditions.
skills.description_zh: 通过分析重试、递归和终止条件，检测 Claw AI 工作流中潜在的无限循环和 Token 用量失控风险。
skills.name: Claw Runaway Loop Detector

skills.description: Synthesis evaluation workflows combining SynFormer-ED, Retrosynthesis Planner, and SAScore through SciMiner.
skills.description_zh: 通过SciMiner结合SynFormer‑ED、Retrosynthesis Planner和SAScore的合成评估工作流
skills.name: Synthesis Evaluation
